title: crambe fruticosa subsp. pinnatifida
intro: Crambe fruticosa subsp. pinnatifida, commonly known as a type of sea buckthorn, is a shrub-like plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used to support overall health and well-being due to its rich content of bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which have been found to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant has been reported to provide health benefits such as reducing oxidative stress, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Crambe fruticosa subsp. pinnatifida include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents.
